title: Forget / do-not-rely and the propagation of their effect to derived hypotheses (PG-02)
purpose: Does forget and do-not-rely change the Memory status; is the forgotten Memory still served; do hypotheses that cite the Memory as evidence stay ACTIVE and reach a new session.

steps.text: قررت أنام بدري رغم إني دايما بسهر

measure.triggerProbe: contains «بس» inside «بسهر» — records whether the contradiction trigger fires on the substring

steps.note: anchored decision; a double-generated hypothesis is expected to attach here if the trigger fires

steps.text: متعتمدش على إني قررت أنام بدري

steps.note: the forgotten Memory must not be served; records whether a hypothesis derived from it is still injected
